components.recipePatchEvidence: Recipe applies the inline source change in libplacebo/src/vulkan/swapchain.c: replace `int qidx = pool->idx_queues;` with `int qidx = 0;`, then checks the changed line. Exact downstream source commit and complete resulting source tree are not retained. The local Mikai wrapper verifies the archive SHA-256, extracts in an owned directory, removes libmpv.so and libmpv.so.2.5.0 aliases, removes host-provided libc/loader/graphics/driver and Qt SONAME patterns, copies internal symlinks to regular files, validates ELF magic, runs patchelf --set-rpath `$ORIGIN` on each retained ELF library and records its resulting SHA-256 in its cache stamp. Stage final hashes are in package SHA256SUMS.
components.sourceBuildInputs: Pinned mpv source commit and published recipe inspected. A GitHub codeload source archive for that exact commit is now retained at release-artifacts/corresponding-source/mpv-19c0fcf89595e6ab33908299207c555b67e81558/mpv-source.tar.gz (SHA-256 8b09edc8e4107595c2ed27ae57d30a18e65d19f5c64910856633f0f992bf1ecf) and the exact ci/build-linux-portable.sh recipe is retained beside it (SHA-256 f7c36af3bd1e02fb1e0a027cd758a132cbad0baed35ac01a552e44831226067a). Recipe identifies Wayland 1.23.1, wayland-protocols 1.41, nv-codec-headers n13.0.19.0, FFmpeg n9.0.2 (GPL and version3 enabled; shared only), shaderc v2024.0 plus git-sync-deps, Vulkan-Headers and Vulkan-Loader vulkan-sdk-1.3.296.0, libplacebo v7.360.1 plus recursive submodules and an inline swapchain.c edit changing qidx assignment to 0, and mutable libass master with autotools build. It configures mpv libmpv/CUDA/Vulkan/Lua enabled. These retained mpv source and recipe materials do not include the dependency source trees/submodules or establish exact asset-to-binary correspondence. Workflow uses a mutable ghcr.io/the-database/animejanai-linux-build:ubuntu2204 tag and apt packages; exact dependency revisions, applicable per-object license/notice closure, and build logs for the selected release asset are not retained. Reproducibility gaps are technical evidence gaps; they are not asserted as independent legal prerequisites. The corresponding-source and license gaps remain open.
